cli.error.handler_identity_mismatch: The handler identity changed. Restore its original identity and source or start another task.
cli.error.handler_snapshot_unstable: The agent's folder changed on every read. Send again once it stops changing.
cli.error.handler_definition_modified: The handler's folder changed during a turn: it is quarantined. Restore the folder, or the person runs terminus handler release.
cli.error.handler_quarantine_unreadable: The engine's quarantine record cannot be read; turns of read-only handlers are refused until it can.
cli.error.handler_identity_required: Several quarantines share that name; pass --identity.
cli.error.handler_unavailable: The handler disappeared or is invalid. Restore its declaration or start another task.
cli.error.handler_no_delegate: This task's policy does not include delegate: it cannot start or send work to other agents, except to reply to its own launcher.
cli.error.handler_inherited_policy_missi: This task's inherited policy is unavailable. Restore its launcher or start a new task; this turn did not run.
cli.error.handler_policy_requires_restar: This task runs under handler limits: change the mode on the next turn, which restarts the process.
cli.error.handler_limit_unenforceable: This provider cannot enforce the handler limits.
cli.error.handler_missing: The working folder does not declare that handler where the task would work; detail.searched says which checkout or ref was read. Use handler list --base.
cli.error.handler_memory_unavailable: This handler runs without its own memory (its store slot is not bound and approved), so there is nowhere to move it.
cli.error.handler_dirty_not_approvable: The handler folder has uncommitted changes: a definition without a fixed digest cannot be approved.
cli.error.handler_request_unknown: The handler does not request that slot or tool.
cli.error.handler_mcp_server_unknown: That server is not in this workspace's MCP catalog.
cli.error.handler_mcp_server_unreachable: Terminus could not list that server's tools, so it cannot tell what it would grant. Nothing was approved.
cli.error.handler_mcp_access_not_disting: The server does not mark which tools only read: it cannot be approved as read. Approve it as slot=server:write if you accept it writes, or do not approve it.
cli.error.handler_not_approved: That handler has no approval to revoke.
cli.error.handler_mcp_hints_not_accepted: A read slot grants the tools the server marks readOnlyHint. Review detail.read_tools and repeat with --accept-hints and exactly that list.
cli.error.handler_request_duplicate: The same slot, server or tool appears twice; say each once.
cli.error.peer_self: This peer key identifies the calling task.
cli.error.peer_mismatch: This peer already exists with a different agent, model or handler.
cli.error.peer_elsewhere: This peer belongs to another tree. Use task send explicitly.
cli.error.pending_revision_conflict: The request changed. Review its updated state before answering.
cli.error.pending_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
cli.error.pending_not_found: The request is no longer available.
cli.error.pending_owner_lost: The process waiting for the answer is no longer available.
